discription: A percussive filtered noise sound, good for hats or general noise effects, with a short ADSR envelope and a resonant low-pass filter.
code: { arg out=0, freq=8000, amp=0.1, gate=1, rq=0.1; var sig; var env = EnvGen.ar(Env.adsr(0.001, 0.05, 0.0, 0.1, curve: -4), gate: gate, doneAction: 2); sig = WhiteNoise.ar; sig = RLPF.ar(sig, freq, rq); sig = sig * amp * env; Out.ar(out, sig ! 2); }
